  • Produce clear reporting, dashboards and visualisations for technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Support information management, governance and technical standards.
  • Prepare high-quality architecture and design documentation.
  • Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and mentoring of departmental staff.
  • Ensure all deliverables comply with established ICT governance frameworks, standards and policies.

  • Extensive experience as an Infrastructure Architect, Data Centre Engineer, Lead Infrastructure Engineer or similar senior technical role.
  • Demonstrated experience designing large-scale enterprise ICT infrastructure environments.
  • Strong background in data centre design and management.
  • Experience producing:
    • Network topology diagrams
    • Data centre layouts
    • Rack elevation drawings
    • Power topology designs
    • Capacity planning documentation
  • Proven experience in availability, capacity and problem management.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure operations, resilience and high-availability design.
  • Experience with infrastructure reporting, analytics and visualisation tools.
  • Experience developing technical documentation, standards and governance artefacts.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

  • Experience working within structured project delivery and governance environments.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience recording and managing technical resource effort and delivery metrics.
